claim: Paired development diagnostics, not by itself evidence of flight-for-measurement.
no_motion_integration_semantics: Idealized current-pose image with exposure signal/noise retained; not real hardware.
frozen_view_semantics: Hold the camera at its initial pose with zero exposure motion; actual vehicle dynamics and odometry continue. Removes view-change information; not a physical baseline.
forced_probe_semantics: Fixed camera; first 24 flight commands are an external geometry-independent lateral probe, then the actor flies. Conditional navigation diagnostic only; never learned sensing motion.
